notes: B1-B5 bootstrap per plan. Pre-existing dev stack (memongo-mongot/memongo-mongod ports 27017/27028) running concurrently but not used; benchmark stack on 27018 created fresh with wiped volumes.
mongot_replication_knowledge_summary: STALE status = queryable but replication stopped; primary freshness indicator. statusDetail[].hostname lists per-mongot state. lastObservedReplicationLagSec is not an officially-spec field on $listSearchIndexes; it comes from mongot telemetry exposed in latestDefinition. Benchmark B5a guards against status==STALE and queryable==false.
